Title: "You cannot play another action modifier to increase this bleed amount"

Messages.Author: wastaz
Messages.Body:
Given that I have the matching disciplines on a vampire (which can be a feat in itself), if I play Quicksilver Contemplation on superior which states

+2 bleed.

and does not have any restrictions on not playing any more action modifiers, can I then play Conditioning directly afterwards? Since conditioning states "You cannot play another action modifier to increase this bleed amount" I feel that it is easy to see that I wouldn't be able to play them in the other order, but if I play quicksilver first, shouldn't I be able to get around this restriction?

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Yes, you may.

The ideal card flow is:

Divine Image at
Quicksilver Contemplation at
Command of the Beast at
Power of One at
Conditioning

See also:  LSJ 02-18-2010

and  Lydia, Grand Praetor and a  Dominate master card acquired via  Lilith's Blessing a  Giant's Blood and  The Book of Going Forth by Night
